tests: net::* (idle/hello deadlines, frames, slow reader, churn, inbound floods, connection cap, batches)
net::rpc_work_deadline_skips_expired_work_and_releases_resources (deadline derived from the measured heavy duration; mutations: no skip, no batch deadline: each fails)
net::rpc_request_buffer_covers_headers_and_body (413 drained before close; its mutation is caught in release 2 of 3 runs, a race)

partiallyResolved: RpcGuard is implemented only in part: connection cap, REQ_BUF, RESP_MAX, batch limits, log limits, a work deadline, a light lane with LIGHT_TURN, response pools after LIGHT_RESP_MAX/HEAVY_RESP_MEM/LIGHT_RESP_MEM (no permits, no QUEUE_WAIT, batches not streamed), queued-body cap, JSON value cap; HEAVY/LIGHT permits, scratch budgets, per-connection rate buckets, per-class compute deadlines and the send watchdog are not implemented
A running request cannot be preempted: one heavy member (<= 30M gas) holds the consensus thread to completion
Light methods are light by response size only (eth_sendRawTransaction executes; receipt and transaction lookups scan the chain): no light compute deadline

tests: lp4 tests/rss_snapshot.rs (full-cap snapshot clones: RSS 0.45 of the model)
private adversarial execution measurements, each case against its own term (evidence/PRIVATE-REVIEW-PACKAGE.md; not in the public repository)
consensus::{a13_* (side states, deep-fork rebuild, boot bound with separate default/below/exact/network-scale assertions, pool caps), a13_bound_breakdown}

A13-DERIVATION.md §2a, §2b, §4 (each assumption ENFORCED / DERIVED / INSPECTION / OPEN)

partiallyResolved: OPEN: gas monotonicity in the domain fields (§4.1)
OPEN: R14/R19 timing is not a worst-case bound (§4.2)
OPEN: allocator overhead and fragmentation (§4.3b); the boot gate keeps a 1/8 reserve for them, which is a margin, not a proof; the 5.13 GiB model total counts requested bytes
OPEN: CPU costs (world-root rebuild, chain scans, pool re-execution, deep-fork rebuild) (§4.5–4.7)

OPEN: RetentionStore and the redb trie are not implemented (§4.10); the specification's node targets <= 750 MiB plus 192 MiB RPC (network.md:158), pocold's in-memory architecture needs 5.13 GiB of model
INSPECTION only: transient-snapshot inventory, one EVM execution at a time, the answer-being-built tree ratio (§4.11, §4.13, §4.16)
DERIVED with stated revm 19.7 facts: execution memory, operation classes (§4.4, §3a)

OPEN (architectural): adoption of a heavier branch at depth <= R_keep (2048, network.md:144) is met only to SIDE_BLOCKS_MAX = 320 (raised from 256; a deeper branch is preserved in the journal, not adopted in one shot); full R_keep needs block bodies off the heap, proposed as D-REORG-REDB (§4.18)
